text:
Riley Bennett: NimbleCare (large telehealth customer) opened a model onboarding request: lightweight summarizer + snippet extractor for visit transcripts. Must be PHI-compliant, support deterministic redaction, and provide embeddings for fast retrieval. They asked for a cost/perf comparison between a tuned 6B quant and a 12B float model. POC requested in 4 weeks. Renewal in 10 weeks - flagged as high priority.
Samir Khosla: Quick clarifying Qs to customer: (1) expected steady QPS? (2) target 95p latency for short summaries? (3) do they need Private deployment with customer-managed KMS/HSM or is Hosted okay for POC?
Eve Laurent: From NimbleCare legal: steady ~15 QPS, spikes to 60 for morning batch, 95p latency target <=200ms, POC can be hosted with sanitized data but production must be private with HSM. They insist on export controls and audit trails.
Dana Ortiz: Security checklist: token-level logging opt-in, redaction must be deterministic and provably applied to outputs, and encryption keys must be HSM-wrapped. We also need a safety eval for PHI leakage and a manual review process for any flagged outputs.
Samir Khosla: I'll scope two baseline configs and a microbench plan. Proposed POC model snippets:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-6b-quant",
  "quant": "int8",
  "kv_cache": true,
  "batch": {"max_batch_size": 6, "max_tokens": 128},
  "latency_target_ms": 160
}
```
and
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-12b",
  "quant": "fp16",
  "kv_cache": true,
  "batch": {"max_batch_size": 10, "max_tokens": 256},
  "latency_target_ms": 200
}
```
Riley Bennett: Good. Add that NimbleCare wants an embeddings endpoint for semantic search rerank. Also request: a short integration guide and sample SDK snippet for streaming summaries.
Samir Khosla: infra-bot, can you run a capacity estimate for 15 QPS steady + 60 spike with both configs? Need estimated nodes, GPU RAM, and cost per hour.
infra-bot: Capacity job queued: nimblecare-capacity-341111-2026-05-01T03:00Z. Results will be posted to #eng-runtime.
Dana Ortiz: For the safety eval harness: sample 300 transcripts with 50 adversarial prompts (PII injection, roleplay with PHI), automated leakage detector + 5% manual review. Output format for eval will be JSONL with fields: transcript_id, prompt, model_output, leakage_score, redaction_verdict, human_review_flag. Retention: flagged items stored for 60 days.
Samir Khosla: Plan for staged rollout: (A) Hosted sanitized POC for 3 weeks -> (B) Dedicated private tenant for integration tests (two weeks) -> (C) On-prem appliance if required. We'll ask NimbleCare to sign POC sanitization addendum.
Riley Bennett: Action items: 1) Samir: microbench plan + cost estimate by Tue; 2) Dana: security checklist + HSM vendor list (AWS CloudHSM, Azure Dedicated HSM, Thales) by Wed; 3) Riley: coordinate legal POC addendum and SFTP option with customer by EOD Mon; 4) infra: post capacity run results when ready.
Eve Laurent: NimbleCare will prepare a small redacted dataset. They prefer SFTP for uploads but can use presigned S3 with extra contract language.
Samir Khosla: Also suggesting lightweight smoke tests for hallucination: entity preservation checks and PHI leakage F1. Will document expected thresholds.
Dana Ortiz: Note: include deterministic tokenizer audit (which tokenizer + version) and sample redaction unit tests in the POC repo.
Riley Bennett: I'll add a docs/devex invite for the POC kickoff so we capture integration feedback early. Scheduling tentative kickoff 2026-05-04 16:00 UTC.
infra-bot: POC kickoff meeting created and invites sent to NimbleCare and internal team.
Riley Bennett: Thanks all. Keeping thread as single place for updates — I'll paste the intake doc + contract stub once legal confirms. :handshake:
